sources.title: GDPR Art. 35 — Data Protection Impact Assessment (DPIA)
sources.why: Directly defines the mandatory DPIA process and the duty to seek the DPO's advice, the exact subject of this dimension.

sources.title: nFADP Art. 21 & 22 — automated decision + DPIA (Switzerland)
sources.why: Sets the Swiss DPIA and data-protection-adviser obligations that run in parallel with the GDPR DPIA for apps targeting Switzerland.

sources.title: GDPR Art. 9 — health data (special category)
sources.why: Processing special-category health data is the trigger that makes a DPIA mandatory and shapes core GDPR compliance for mHealth apps.
